Although the description directs viewers to a Hashflare cloud-mining bonus through a referral URL, it does not establish the bonus amount, eligibility, fees, or outcome. The material therefore presents cryptocurrency purchasing and operational instruction, without a concrete deceptive earnings promise or guaranteed reward, rather than reporting on a third-party scam.
